text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "Taiki-senpai! Are you ready, yes!?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay!
I am ready to start anytime!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And now, the gates open!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Get ready, get set—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Go!
(Clatter, clatter, clatter...!)

On the road in front of the dorms, El Condor Pasa and
Taiki Shuttle suddenly burst into a sprint at the same time.
...What are they doing?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Perfect!
With this, there's no doubt, desu!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! No problem!
Tonight's dinner is gonna be extravagant!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, truth is, YES!
A popular cafe is having an event right now selling their new pizza, YES!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
From super-sized pizzas to regular size,
they're all just a single coin! First-come, first-served!
What's more, no limits per person!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So I teamed up with El and we've been
training hard to get that big pizza, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The big size really is gigantic,
so it takes two people to carry it, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like,
would you care to join in too, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: If three of us go, we can carry more at once!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Nice idea!
Let's have a party with a giant pizza!

Before I knew what was happening, the two of them swept me along,
and we ended up heading to a popular cafe.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We've arrived...! 
The shop is over that way, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow! It's so lively!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
There are way more spectators than expected!
Maybe we should come up with a strategy, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
There are way more spectators than expected!
Maybe we should come up with a strategy, desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pressure!? Ah, I see!
It's what you call the aura of the strong, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh! That looks like so much fun~!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! The fastest, strongest, most overwhelming!
After all, I'm the world's El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I will go all out as well!
Hehe, I'm itching for action!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's about to staaart!
Let's go, Taiki-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna get the biggest pizza of them all!!

Taking great care not to bump into anyone,
I head toward the piping hot pizza. And then—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "Extra-large pizza, secureeeeed!! DEEEEEESU!!"
A powerful voice echoed into the sky.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A gap...!
I see, that requires some technique, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, that is absolutely true!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: El and I are Umamusume, so if we bump into other people, that would be super dangerous!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In practice, I just ran with all my might,
but I mustn't try to power through this...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Trainer!
Leave it to me, El is the world's strongest Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I will accomplish this, without fail!
Here I go, Taiki-senpai!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm all ready to go too!
I'm gonna get the biggest pizza of all!!

Weaving through the gaps between people without missing a beat,
El Condor Pasa sprinted
in pursuit of the piping hot pizza!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "Extra-large pizza, secureeeeed!! DEEEEEESU!!"

"Having skillfully secured the pizza with deft footwork,
El Condor Pasa seemed to have learned something
from this experience."
